items.article: A quarter of all marriages in Scotland involve couples who don't live here but see it as the ultimate wedding destination. Hayden and Savannah had never set foot in Scotland before they decided it was the perfect place to get married last May. The couple, from Pennsylvania in the USA, wanted a destination wedding that would take their family and friends on an adventure with them. They considered locations across Europe, before deciding on Scotland after Savannah saw photographs of a castle wedding online. "I think it was on Pinterest," she said. "Somebody got married in a castle and I was like, 'Oh, I have to do that'." The pair are far from alone in seeing Scotland as the ultimate romantic destination. Nearly a quarter of all marriages registered in Scotland last year involved couples who did not live in the country.
